Bug_Title: NP: Method may return null, but is declared @Nonnull (NP_NONNULL_RETURN_VIOLATION)
Bug_Details:
This method may return a null value, but the method (or a superclass method
which it overrides) is declared to return @Nonnull.
Bug_Explanation: The method getNonNullString(boolean returnNull) is supposed to return a non-null String but can return null if the input parameter is true. This violates the non-null contract.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case calls the method `showBug` with the argument `true`, which leads to calling `getNonNullString(true)`. This will return null, violating the non-null contract, and causing the test to fail with a NullPointerException or an assertion failure.
